name: Shikoku Henro: Temples 1-23
description: The first prefecture of the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, walked clockwise from Temple 1 Ryozenji at Naruto to Temple 23 Yakuoji at Hiwasa: the Yoshino river plain, the mountain crossing to Temple 12 Shosanji, Tokushima city, the climbs to Temples 20 and 21, and the coast road south. Built from a personal CalTopo map with pilgrim huts, Henro Houses, temple lodgings, campgrounds and onsen within 3 km of the route; scripts/process-shikoku-caltopo.ts turns the map's export into the GPX. The out-and-back from Temple 12 to its Okunoin on the summit of Mt Shosanji is a side trip, not part of the route distance.

dataSource.text: Track, accommodation and rest areas from a personal CalTopo map of the Shikoku 88 temples; Temples 3-9 and the Shosanji Okunoin positioned from OpenStreetMap.
